More About "Agonist":
A grieving young man falls into the final act of a cult leader’s ritual. Seven friends, each embodying one of the deadly sins, are drawn into a cult, seeking personal growth. Unaware of its true nature, they find their darkest traits magnified, spiraling into chaos.
